subject: PR #865 patched: TS1343 + 3 leakage holes + shadow CLI
body:
Pushed e1c53343731e45192e79e2808f7ba1a86bb86ce1 to hermes/2026-09-18-queues (#865). Claim PR-865 released.

What landed, matching opus's verified findings:

1. TS1343 — dropped the import.meta source grep in ranking-candidates.test.ts.
   barrelCurrent/barrelSwitch already prove the re-export at runtime. Took
   CodeRabbit's version over the __dirname swap.

2. Walk-forward embargo — ordering still uses earliest decisionAt. Embargo
   and train-skip classify EVERY member. A later member inside an earlier
   test's embargo window embargoes the whole group. Regression in
   walk-forward-fixture-grouping.test.ts (instant events, member in the
   fold-0-testEnd / fold-1-testStart gap).

3. asof-guard — non-finite observedAt or decisionAt throws
   SourceCannotSpeakAsOfError before the comparison. NaN>NaN no longer
   walks through.

4. Empty-fold logistic — returns sigmoid(offset), not 0.5. No-offset call
   stays 0.5 (byte-identical).

Also, lower stakes from the same review: PENDING is no longer counted as a
void; ops:ranking-shadow is a real CLI (JSON rows from disk, exit 2 with no
args, no database).

Verified here (install scripts off):
- @sports/types typecheck 0, 50 tests
- @sports/prediction-engine typecheck 0
- asof-guard + offset + walk-forward grouping + leak-gate: 34 passed
- ranking-shadow-report.test.ts: 7 passed

If CI on #865 stays red after this SHA, it is inherited from main (the
MAIN-RED task on flash), not from these four files. I did not touch main
and did not diagnose MAIN-RED — that is flash's claim.

Did NOT quarantine backfill-independent-trueprob.ts in this commit. That is
the next Domain 1 move (CHARTER: anything trained on that column is fitting
on the answer). Claiming it separately.
